originPolicy: Local test origin admitted through existing GOONK_TEST_ORIGIN build option; selected source has no hardcoded test origin.

browserPolicy.context: fresh owned context on dedicated Chrome9224; all10pages created and closed by this harness

runtimeGuard.tests: Three unit tests cover exact match and rejection of missing or inconsistent engine/data pairs.

observabilityLimit: Published Main0.4.34 exposes HP,attack,defense,speed,damage min/max andcost. Growth,AI/FV andshots are verified by frozen source contracts and explicitly attributed historical native evidence; no absent native getter is claimed.
nativeErrorFilter: \] ERROR |failed to resolve identifier|identifier.*does not exists?|unknown identifier|unresolved|fatal error|schema.*error

fixtures.scope: Ordinary VMAP inputs only, installed into the owned engine FS after startup. No published map or game definitions modified.
corrections: Removed unused purchase-budget map event and custom town name without localization.
Normalized instanceName suffixes and header references to native _<integer> format.
Enabled normal mainTown.generateHero for AI player so any ordinary starting artifact has a recipient.
fixtures.knownBaselineMapLimitation: Published baseline map retains non-numeric instance names; CMap::parseUidCounter logs ERROR for those names. The fixture corrections above are not a production map correction and this data-only release does not claim to close that baseline issue.

nativeDiagnosticBaselineComparison.scope: One normalized ordinary Castle map on identical Main0.4.34 engine: full boot/mod validation plus native town. Baseline changes only the native FS manifest to pinned2da before main; candidate contains the reviewed66/63/6 overlays. Not a nine-town warning-free claim.

baseline.manifestControl: Pinned2da original mod manifest; all definitions otherwise identical to candidate packaged bytes
